edzip.1-1.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:26-37 identifies collected fields and prohibits unrelated contact, account, and sensitive data; components/StudentResponseForm.tsx:352-401 displays that notice and collects grade, class, and name/class alias.

edzip.1-2.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:17-24 states the collection/use purpose for classroom demand-curve response collection and statistics.

edzip.1-3.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:41-46 states retention and deletion timing; app/teacher/responses/page.tsx:257-275 implements teacher-initiated deletion.

edzip.3-1.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:94-99 states access, correction, deletion, and suspension requests; app/privacy/page.tsx:112-124 supplies the contact route.

edzip.4-1.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:103-109 requires the teacher to confirm guardian-consent procedures for under-14 students and says the app does not collect consent automatically; components/StudentResponseForm.tsx:352-355 warns against unrelated personal data.

edzip.5-1.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:112-124 names the privacy contact role and provides an inquiry link.

edzip.5-2.evidence: app/privacy/page.tsx:60-67 states personal data is not provided to third parties except as required by law.
